data.name: Auto-generation must meet requirements; insufficient manual staffing triggers a warning only, while empty shifts cannot be saved.
data.value: Automatic generation must meet the requirements; insufficient manual staffing will only trigger a warning, while shifts cannot be saved if they are empty.

data.name: Balance early, middle, and late shifts as evenly as possible
data.value: Balance early, middle and late shifts as evenly as possible

data.name: Cannot be lower than the minimum headcount; satisfy as much as possible when overrides and breaks allow. Leave blank for automatic assignment.
data.value: Must not be lower than the minimum headcount; meet the target as far as possible when overrides and rest requirements allow. Leave blank for automatic assignment.

data.name: Coverage and rest are prioritized; redundancy may decrease during swaps. Rotation is not allowed for teams of three with at least 16 hours of rest. Scheduling is based on actual 8-hour continuous shifts; local time may change during daylight saving time transitions.
data.value: Coverage and rest are prioritised; staffing levels may decrease during swaps. Rotation is not allowed for teams of three with at least 16 hours of rest. Scheduling is based on actual continuous 8-hour shifts; local time may change during daylight saving time transitions.

data.name: Fixed three shifts per day, at least one person per shift; multiple people per shift allowed.
data.value: There are three fixed shifts per day, with at least one person per shift. Multiple people per shift are allowed.

data.name: This is a rule template available for sharing across multiple teams. Members, rotation order, and schedule start points are managed by the team. Modifying the template will not regenerate any saved shifts.
data.value: This is a rule template that can be shared across multiple teams. Team membership, rotation order and schedule start points are managed by each team. Modifying the template will not regenerate any saved shifts.
